# ssp_cloud_connector_config (Resource)

Manages the pre-deployment configuration for the **Cloud Connector** feature.

Cloud Connector is a prerequisite for features that require cloud connectivity,
such as **Malware Prevention** in `CLOUD` analysis mode. The configuration
selects the cloud region where analysis traffic is sent.

This is a singleton — only one configuration exists per SSP platform.

Once Cloud Connector has been deployed, the region cannot be changed until
the feature is removed and re-deployed (`configurable` becomes `false`).

Use `terraform import ssp_cloud_connector_config.this singleton` to adopt
an existing configuration.

Corresponds to `GET/PUT /ssp/lcm/cloud-connector/config` and
`GET /ssp/lcm/cloud-connector/config/status`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) Cloud Connector region identifier (e.g. `west.us` for *United States 1*, `west.eu` for *European Union 1*). Use `GET /ssp/lcm/cloud-connector/regions` to retrieve the list of available regions.

### Read-Only

- `config_message` (String) Informational message accompanying `config_status`.
- `config_status` (String) Configuration status from the platform. One of `NOT_CONFIGURED`, `DEPLOYMENT_REQUIRED`, or `CONFIGURATION_APPLIED`.
- `configurable` (Boolean) Whether the region can still be changed. Becomes `false` once Cloud Connector is deployed.
- `fqdn` (String) FQDN of the selected Cloud Connector region. Resolved automatically from `region`.
- `id` (String) Always `singleton` for this resource.
- `region_name` (String) Human-readable name of the selected region (e.g. `US 1`, `EU 1`). Resolved automatically from `region`.
